description: Page, Knight, Queen and King of Wands in tarot: upright and reversed meanings, and how to read court cards as people, parts of yourself or approaches.
lede: The Page, Knight, Queen and King of Wands bring the energy of fire to a tarot spread. Court cards can be people, parts of yourself or ways of approaching a situation.

faces.alt: Four original gold-linework tarot card faces in a row, in order: Page of Wands, Knight of Wands, Queen of Wands and King of Wands. Each shows its rank and a wand icon with the card name beneath. No scenes are drawn.
faces.caption: The four Wands court cards in order, shown as simple rank-and-suit card faces.
